prompt: Objective: find why a parts distributor's same-day shipping rate fell from 92% to 70%. What you've learned: order volume is flat and couriers report normal pickup times. Latest finding: order picking time doubled after new handheld scanners were introduced. What is the best next step?

options.text: Compare courier performance route by route
options.feedback: Already answered: couriers report normal pickup times.

options.text: Price out a return to the old scanners
options.feedback: That jumps to a fix before knowing which step the scanners slowed.

options.text: Find which picking step the new scanners slowed down
options.feedback: Right. Picking time doubled after the scanners arrived, so the next step is pinpointing where.

options.text: Check whether order volume shifted between regions
options.feedback: Volume is flat. The finding points inside the warehouse.

explanation: Picking time doubled after new scanners were introduced, so find which picking step slowed.
